sources.title: Contrastive Learning - Generative AI for Biomedical Research
sources.snippet: Contrastive learning depends on what we decide should count as "the same example." If two different crops of the same dog should map nearby, the model must learn the concept of the dog rather than one exact pixel pattern. Common augmentations include: random crop and resize, horizontal flip, color jitter, grayscale conversion, blur.
